basic_info.description: Welcome to 422 Waller Street, a rare Lower Haight Victorian condominium that blends historic charm with everyday convenience. Inside, a 2-bedroom, 1-bath flat awaits with soaring high ceilings, intricate moulding, freshly painted interiors, built-ins, and refinished Douglas Fir floors. The open floor plan connects the living area, dining area, and kitchen in one seamless flow, extending into your private, deeded yard, an urban oasis perfect for entertaining or unwinding under the stars. The spacious bath boasts a clawfoot tub and elegant finishes, striking the right balance of luxury and charm. Bonus perks include a large private storage room, laundry and one deeded parking space in the garage. All this just one block from Duboce Park and moments from Hayes Valley, the Castro, MUNI, cafes, restaurants, and shopping. Welcome home to City living with Victorian soul.
